message: In the Direct Current vapour-compression cooler (Direct Current (DC), battery-driven cooling) (C1), Sam, the door-opening infiltration add-on has closure need. To check it I used hand conversion reusing the batch infiltration estimate (E15) to form the infiltration electric conversion (E19). I found 0.048 kilowatt-hour electric per day from 0.12 kilowatt-hour thermal at Coefficient of Performance (COP, cooling per electricity) 2.5, according to American Society of Heating, Refrigerating and Air-Conditioning Engineers Handbook, 2022. I propose accept two fixed loadings per day with Polyvinyl Chloride strip curtain (PVC, flexible plastic) as operations discipline. My position: not ready because battery and cloudy refill closure by you remains open. In the 100 millimetre Polyurethane insulated cold room (Polyurethane (PU), closed-cell foam insulation) (C1), Manager, the steady night load and heat rejection has efficiency risk. To check it I used steady split reusing the combined thermal load (E9) and the wall gain estimate (E3). I found about 6.4 kilowatt-hour thermal steady load near 2.6 kilowatt-hour electric per day, according to Azzouz and co-workers, 2020. I propose low-speed evaporator fan circulation over crates plus shaded air-cooled condenser with condensate drain and ice-bank to shave night peaks. My position: not ready because system autonomy sign-off is still pending.
